referents.why: 'when I laid the foundations': the first person inside the LORD's speech is the LORD.
'where were you': second person, the addressee Job.
The implied subject of the imperative 'tell' is the one told, Job.

links.why: The infinitive 'when I founded the earth' is a temporal clause nested in the question.
links.category: temporal clause nested in a question

links.why: 'Tell me, if you have understanding': the condition cl3 conditions the command cl2; the if-link runs from what is conditioned to its condition (R3).

groups.why: The speaker of 'tell' is the LORD, not Job (the builder's sender was the one told). Under R3 the turn's part is the conditional group, not the bare condition.
The conditional 'if you have understanding' conditions the command 'tell me' (R3).

cant_tell.what: Whether the Hebrew has an 'im (if) before 'you have understanding'
cant_tell.why: The parser's opens_with for cl3 is null, so the if-link rests on the English and the sense; the particle should be checked against the text.
